To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

from the time period of January 1st, 2023 to January 1st, 2024, any email, text, or  electronic communications relating to the relinquishment of the subject easement for property Address: "4900-5050 North Race Street" and/or "4900 N Race Street". Additional search terms include: Bill file number 23-1478; parcel number - 02144-00-131-000; Project Number: 2023-RELINGQ-0000016-01; site development review - 2022-PROJMSTR-0000280. Messages from staff associated with the Denver Mayor's Office, Denver City Council, Denver City Council District 9, Denver Economic and and Opportunity Department and City Planning Department included but not limited to Lucas Palmisano, Jason Gallardo, Brianne White, Victoria Tonikian, Jon Ewing, Michael Johnston, and Darrell Watson.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Lani Rush
